concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-cards-android-drop-in-earlier-versions]] — historical Android Cards Drop-in v4.x.x Advanced-flow guide for card display, server payments, results and stored-card examples; Sessions links and save-switch naming conflict require qualification.
warnings: The v4.x.x requirement specifies Advanced flow, while several inline navigation links point to Sessions.
The storage-switch prose names showStoredPaymentMethods but its adjacent snippet uses setShowStorePaymentField; the token section also mixes actionComponentData and paymentComponentData nomenclature.
The introduction's card-data server shorthand is qualified by the PCI guide: encrypted cardholder data passes through the merchant server; merchant SAQ A eligibility must be assessed.
Go v10.4.0-labeled example imports /v9/ packages; snippets are not proven compatible or complete.
